Compose a tree of analytical steps

blueprint.Rd

Connect a producer to its consumer with %=>%. Routes separated by commas in blueprint() start independently from the original experiment. Use fork() to share an intermediate output and br() for a side route that leaves the outer connection available. See vignette("blueprint").

Usage

blueprint(...)

lhs %=>% rhs

Arguments

...

One or more routes, optionally named. A trailing comma is allowed.

lhs, rhs

Steps, routes, forks, side branches or reusable blueprints.

Value

blueprint() returns a validated blueprint. Printing it draws each step beneath its producer and shows its result ID. %=>% returns an ordered route for use in a blueprint. Neither constructor runs the analysis.

Examples

blueprint(
  step_preprocess() %=>% step_dea_limma() %=>% fork(
    step_volcano(),
    step_filter_sig_vars() %=>% step_heatmap()
  )
)
#> Blueprint (root accepts exp)
#> └─ node_1  step_preprocess() (exp)
#>   └─ node_2  step_dea_limma() (contrast)
#>     ├─ node_3  step_volcano() (terminal)
#>     └─ node_4  step_filter_sig_vars() (filtered_exp)
#>       └─ node_5  step_heatmap() (terminal)
blueprint(scores = step_pca(), differential = step_dea_limma())
#> Blueprint (root accepts exp)
#> ├─ node_1  step_pca() [scores] (terminal)
#> └─ node_2  step_dea_limma() [differential] (contrast)
